links.comparator_used: Baseline LLM prompting without a base-rate guardrail, on the cue versions of the cases
links.outcome: Cue-linked lure diagnosis selection by LLMs
links.effect: Lure selection fell to 28.4% with base-rate guardrail prompting, from 84.9% for baseline LLMs on matched cue responses. Clinician participants selected the lure in 27.8%.
links.quote: Base-rate guardrail prompting reduced lure selection to 28.4%; rare-or-serious prompting raised it to 93.2%.
